searchQuery.title: Search Query
searchQuery.description: Keywords to search for products (e.g., 'vintage prints', 'handmade jewelry'). Uses /search endpoint.

maxProducts.title: Maximum Products
maxProducts.description: Maximum number of products to scrape (0 = unlimited). Default is 50.

minPrice.title: Minimum Price
minPrice.description: Filter products by minimum price (optional, in USD)

maxPrice.title: Maximum Price
maxPrice.description: Filter products by maximum price (optional, in USD)

enrichDetails.title: Enrich with Product Details
enrichDetails.description: Fetch additional details from product pages (slower but more data). Default: OFF
